## Approved Scope And Firewall Interpretation

The approval has these exact consequences:

1. The approved packet is complete and exclusive for normative Stage B
   authorship. An author may use no unlisted local, historical, implementation,
   audit, validation, or model-memory source.
2. The information firewall restricts normative authority. Existing Citlali
   behavior, historical comments, unadmitted development material, and
   inherited configuration values cannot invent, complete, or override a
   SCI-JINC requirement.
3. The inherited `45 m` radial-scale denominator, current TolTEC shape
   parameters, mode-dependent `r_max` defaults, and every other unsupported
   implementation realization remain unauthorized evidence. A route without
   an authorized numerical realization remains explicitly unavailable.
4. Approval authorizes implementation-blind Stage B contract authorship only.
   It establishes no implementation conformity, representation fidelity,
   validation, achieved performance, numerical readiness, production
   readiness, or scientific freeze of the eventual Stage B contract.
5. Exact-byte control is solely document-authoring integrity. It creates no
   runtime provenance, per-sample auditability, extra diagnostic, or
   implementation-history preservation requirement.
